caseSemantics.signed-supervise and signed-sandbox: Actual runAssurance fails at the real credential-free resolver with AgentResponderUnavailableError/AGENT_RESPONDER_UNAVAILABLE. Original error is retained, ASSURANCE_RUN_ABORTED is written and the actual session seal is verified independently against the monitor public key pinned before artifacts. Ledger chain and admitted ledger-row trust verification pass; assurance_runs stays empty.
caseSemantics.unsigned-false and unsigned-true: AMC_NO_SIGN=1 routes actual rows and seal into the unsigned store regardless of the noSign input. Literal unsigned values are asserted. Signed DB/WAL/SHM bytes, modes, inodes, link counts and signed rows are exactly unchanged across the unsigned call. Real signed operational controls before and after pass independent cryptographic and trust verification.
caseSemantics.first-row-fault: Owned SQLite BEFORE INSERT trigger aborts the actual first-row helper transaction. Session, evidence and assurance row sets and blob inventory roll back; db.inTransaction is false. Removing only the owned trigger permits a genuine retry and signed seal.
caseSemantics.seal-fault: Owned SQLite BEFORE UPDATE trigger blocks actual abort sealing. Original real resolver error retains its code/reason and has the genuine SQLite cause. ABORTED row persists; the session lacks its seal and actual ledger/chain verdicts remain false.
caseSemantics.seal-helper-identity: The existing abort helper returns the same independently constructed typed error object and attaches the genuine trigger cause. This narrow identity control does not claim a provider response or healthy seal.
caseSemantics.store-guard: Unsigned store opening without AMC_NO_SIGN=1 refuses before creating that store; original signed bytes and rows stay unchanged.

SQL seal faults are expected negative checks; ledger verdict false and missing seal remain explicit.
No P0-55 withSealedSession helper is added, no shared paths are transferred, and no inherited unresolved requirement is cleared.
Only own runtime state directories were cleaned after public row/byte snapshots and streams were saved. Existing logs/artifacts were retained.
Post-failure readonly row inspection may coordinate SQLite sidecars. It is separate from the original in-loop signed-byte isolation boundary.
Root budget, compiled CLI, checkpoint, export and final combined checks are separate evidence and are not absorbed into these counts.
